fr3_root_numeric_evidence.interpretation: High counts are mostly tiny/skinny detail/casing triangles, often all three corners opposed. Many heights exceed4float32ULP, so they are not all simple quantization noise; internal/cavity/winding details remain plausible. No automatic normal reversal is justified.

visual_validation.heatmap_policy: Original actual-material preview compared with the same geometric triangles and original normals, split only into temporary preview parts; existing opposed-normal faces emit red. visibility_metrics.note: Red-emission face masks diagnose visibility in the sampled views, not aesthetic quality or guaranteed visibility over the full workspace. Tiny/subpixel faces may remain below the chosen pixel thresholds.
